program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u021/system/state/workspace/programs')

program_path=program_dir/'task-10ed8747.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    width = len(grid[0])
    full_colors = {row[0] for row in grid if len(row) == width and all(cell == row[0] for cell in row)}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        colors = set(row)
        if len(colors) == 2:
            fg = next((c for c in colors if c in full_colors), None)
            if fg is not None and row.count(fg) < width:
                out[r] = [cell if cell == fg else 1 for cell in row]
    return out
'''
